fact: The ministry's annual report for 2025 states Morocco rose to 90th in the UN EGDI in 2024 from 101st in 2022 and restates the Digital Morocco 2030 targets (80% user satisfaction, 50% faster processing, 40% simpler procedures).
title: حصيلة وزارة الانتقال الرقمي وإصلاح الإدارة برسم سنة 2025
publisher: Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Réforme de l'Administration
